01-actual-system.title: From GitHub evidence to user-owned organization
labels: Implemented local app: three logical data areas in SQLite; AWS runtime remains a separate design.
Bounded evidence + retrieved canonical candidates → strict JSON
Tools disabled · review-first results · separate durable spending ledger
Deferred cloud: DynamoDB Core / Intelligence / Organization + SQS workers + EventBridge.

02-retrieval-and-generation.title: Retrieve candidates, augment context, validate decisions
labels: Sparse candidate retrieval is implemented. Dense embeddings and a neural reranker are absent.
Up to 8 phrases + short ID records
No tool loop; no automatic retry
A ranking stage is not automatically a reranker
BM25 was an alternative offline candidate retriever. No dense+sparse fusion or cross-encoder was used.

03-evidence-and-chunking.title: Chunk for purpose, while keeping the source visible
labels: Implemented heuristic: Markdown blocks and heading filters; no fixed token windows or semantic splitter.
Character truncation may cut a sentence. Early blocks may omit decisive later evidence or negation.
The app's v2 wrapper removes selected RST directives; frozen v1 benchmark profiles remain unchanged.

04-controlled-analysis-loop.title: Loop engineering: spend once, reconcile safely
labels: Analysis completion, label coverage, freshness and human review are independent states.
A stale result can still be a historical processing fact
Keep the receipt and cost; discard unsafe assignment references. Never repeat uncertain calls automatically.

05-harness-and-tokenomics.title: Harness engineering: reserve before generation
labels: Original experiment ceiling $5; fixed request limits and adaptive run dollars are distinct controls.
Count request is a separate HTTP attempt
Renew selected counters explicitly; preserve history
Lifetime accounting and cumulative dollars remain
Reviewed run hold under an operator's dollar ceiling
Finite grant: at most 2 HTTP attempts / generation
Transfer held money into a call reservation
No infinite calls; no automatic paid re-analysis
16,041 input + 3,414 output tokens (702 reasoning included) → $0.003319 ledger estimate; 40 HTTP requests.

06-evaluation-evidence.title: Evaluate retrieval, generation and the harness separately
labels: Measured Phase 0.5 regression results; small reused corpus limits all generalization claims.
References approved; labels never in prompts
TF-IDF and BM25 each retrieve all 52 expected labels.
This is shortlist coverage, not evidence of semantic correctness.
Research limit: regression success is not an independent test
No dense / reranker / contextual-retrieval trial, RAGAS score, calibrated confidence or production benchmark.

07-contextual-retrieval-comparison.title: Context preservation is not Contextual Retrieval
labels: Anthropic's 2024 technique is a research reference; GitHub Manager has not implemented or evaluated it.
Locally selected README text and phrase spans
Sparse search over canonical taxonomy records
No dense index or neural reranker
Prefix each chunk before embedding and BM25
Published retrieval-failure results are vendor data
Not comparable to our classification micro F1
Add trusted repo + heading metadata to passages
Measure relevant-passage recall per input token
Evaluate sparse / dense / fusion / reranker arms
Include indexing cost and privacy authorization
Test the causal mechanism before adopting a larger stack
Can added context recover missed supporting evidence without increasing false project membership or reviewer effort?

08-future-experiment-roadmap.title: A measured route to stronger retrieval and generation
labels: Proposed experiments only. Preserve the current sparse baseline and every original evaluation record.
ACL filters before and after retrieval
At most one broader retrieval pass
Rerank only when candidate set large
No learned claim without held-out eval
Promotion criteria · a constrained quality / cost frontier
Report candidate recall, passage recall, ranking quality, exact-set accuracy, project false positives and abstentions.
Measure end-to-end tokens, indexing amortization, latency, accepted labels and human correction effort.
Adopt a component only when its independent gain justifies added dollars, operational burden and privacy exposure.
Distributed DynamoDB / SQS correctness remains a separate production-readiness gate.
Engineering contribution: the contract around intelligence
Ground decisions in bounded evidence, protect user memory, retain receipts and make cost and state changes auditable.
